title: Emirium
description: Emirium Mod introduces a powerful new endgame ore that allowing players to craft ultimate-tier tools and armor.
body:
# 🌌 **Emirium: The Ultimate Endgame Expansion**
Is Netherite no longer enough for your adventures? Do you need more power, speed, and durability at the absolute edge of Minecraft? Emirium is a fully survival-oriented endgame progression mod that pushes past vanilla boundaries, introducing a brand new tier designed to be exactly two steps above Netherite equipment.

If you want to fill the late-game void and craft a true master-tier set, get ready to descend into the deepest depths of the End dimension.

# **✨ Why Download Emirium?**

True Endgame Goal: Gives a brand new purpose to exploring The End dimension after defeating the Ender Dragon.

Balanced Progression: You cannot skip tiers. Crafting Emirium requires vanilla high-tier items like Netherite, Nether Stars, and Eyes of Ender.


# **💎 Emirium Ore & Properties**
The journey begins only when you have conquered the Overworld and the Nether. Emirium is no ordinary mineral; finding and harvesting it is a true test of strength.

Spawning & Generation: Naturally generates only in The End dimension, between Y: 10 and Y: 55. It is highly rare.

Mining Requirement: This dense ore requires immense power to break. You must use at least a Netherite Pickaxe (or an upgraded Emirium Pickaxe). Lower-tier tools will destroy the block without dropping anything.

Blast Resistance: Emirium Ore is completely TNT-proof. It cannot be destroyed or dislodged by any explosions.

# **🔥 Refinement & Crafting Progression**
You cannot shape raw Emirium into tools immediately. Unlocking its true potential requires a multi-stage metallurgical process:

Raw Emirium: Obtained by mining Emirium Ore with a proper pickaxe.

Emirium Ingot: Smelt the Raw Emirium in a regular Furnace or Blast Furnace to get the pure ingot.

Emirium Block: Crafted by combining 9 Emirium Ingots. Used for storage or high-tier decoration.

Heavy Emirium: Pure Emirium is too dense on its own, so it must be alloyed with Netherite for stabilization.

Recipe: 4x Emirium Ingot + 1x Netherite Ingot

Emirium Core: The most critical, mystical, and expensive component of the mod. It acts as the heart of all Emirium armor pieces.

Recipe: 4x Heavy Emirium + 2x Eye of Ender + 2x Netherite Ingot + 1x Nether Star

# **🛡️ Emirium Armor Set**
Engineered to be two tiers stronger than Netherite, this set turns you into a walking fortress against the most dangerous entities in the game. Every single piece requires an Emirium Core embedded at its center:

🪖 Emirium Helmet: 5x Heavy Emirium + 1x Emirium Core

👕 Emirium Chestplate: 8x Heavy Emirium + 1x Emirium Core

👖 Emirium Leggings: 7x Heavy Emirium + 1x Emirium Core

🥾 Emirium Boots: 4x Heavy Emirium + 1x Emirium Core

# **⚔️ Emirium Tools & Weapons**
Standard wooden sticks cannot withstand the sheer weight and force of Heavy Emirium. Therefore, all tool handles must be crafted using Blaze Rods. Just like the armor, every tool features stats and durability that sit exactly two steps above their Netherite equivalents.

🗡️ Emirium Sword: 2x Heavy Emirium + 1x Blaze Rod

⛏️ Emirium Pickaxe: 3x Heavy Emirium + 2x Blaze Rod

🪓 Emirium Axe: 3x Heavy Emirium + 2x Blaze Rod

🧹 Emirium Shovel: 1x Heavy Emirium + 2x Blaze Rod

🧑‍🌾 Emirium Hoe: 2x Heavy Emirium + 2x Blaze Rod


# **🛠️ Technical Details**

Supported Version: ( now just for ) Minecraft 1.21

Gameplay Style: Vanilla+ / Endgame Progression / Survival Compatible
